title: Developer MIA Since iOS 26
text: Widgy has become a headache since the release of iOS 26, which broke Tap to Reload and also doesn’t honor the Liquid Glass Off option. Tapping on a widget to reload it, e.g., a calendar widget, opens the Widgy app—which it is expressly not supposed to do.  And it insists on ruining my black widget on black wallpaper by adding an ugly liquid glass border even with Turn Off Liquid Glass selected in setting up transparency. The developer has been dragging his feet getting these bugs fixed for so long, I felt this review was in order, especially since there is zero support for the app apart from an indirect and annoyingly inefficient user forum. Have begun looking for a replacement app. For my part, irresponsible development is a deal breaker.
